THE INVERSION (the deeper question Part 1 did not answer)\n\nPart 1 designed the **body** — how a task flows Agent99→PCC1→PCC2/3→PA. It assumed tasks arrive. The engine that does this already has all its organs in the system — they have never been wired into a loop.\n\n---\n\n## VI. THE CHARGE MODEL (the formal busy-condition)\n\nLet `C(t)` = total pheromone charge in the incarnate pipeline at time `t`.\n\n```\nC(t) = Σ charge(pᵢ)   over all pheromones pᵢ in the reservoir\n```\n\n- **Charge source** = `follow-the-fucks-v1` (LIVE, `/api/soul/priority`): `caps_words + exclamations` from `emotional_markers`, plus signal-density (the 86–110/100 the scouts already stamp).\n- **Decay**: positive trails decay fast (use-it-or-lose-it); negative trails decay slow (a dead-end stays a warning longer — per antifragile doctrine, failures are persistent fuel).\n- **Branching factor β** = average child-pheromones deposited per blueprinted node.\n\n**The three regimes:**\n| β | Behavior | Meaning |\n|---|----------|---------|\n| β < 1 | charge decays → terminates | archive exhausted (never, in practice) |\n| β = 1 | steady state | one-in-one-out |\n| β > 1 | charge grows → **needs a ceiling** | the real condition of a deep archive |\n\n**Busy iff `C(t) > 0`. Perpetual iff `β ≥ 1` while unwalked territory exists. Safe iff a homeostat caps `C(t)`.** That homeostat is Section VIII.\n\n---\n\n## VII. THE FIVE PHEROMONE GENERATORS (why the well never runs dry)\n\nThe engine stays fed because blueprinting *produces* more pheromone than it consumes, from five independent sources:\n\n1. **Fractal sub-questions (L80).** Every blueprint that answers one question exposes its children. The \"NOT WALKED\" list is not a footnote — it is the primary fuel injector. Each frontier line is a trail-head.\n2. **Dooku adversarial drift (LIVE, `/api/soul/shadow`, Mistral-7b).** Every blueprint is attacked. Each `drift_indicator` Dooku returns is a *new* pheromone — \"blueprint around this contradiction.\" The swarm is kept busy by its own adversary.
